name: DAP-G Bayesian multi-SNP association analysis
model_likelihood: Multiple linear regression for a quantitative trait after residualizing outcome and genotype predictors on controlled covariates.
prior: Independent inclusion indicators and spike-and-slab effect priors; nonzero effects have a normal mixture over a scale grid, with equal weights by default.
inference_algorithm: DAP deterministic plausible-model search using sure independence screening, with approximation-error estimation; DAP-G identifies redundant signal clusters and excludes simultaneous member inclusions.
estimand: Posterior model probabilities; SNP PIPs; cluster SPIPs; signal-level Bayesian FDR discoveries.
data_input: Individual outcome and genotypes; alternatively LD R, marginal effect estimates and standard errors, n and phenotype SST.
tunable_settings: Effect-size scale grid phi_k; mixture weights pi_k (default 1/K, optionally estimated); within-cluster genotype R2 threshold (default 0.25); Bayesian FDR target alpha.
